security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks and TypeScript template literal types. The only confirmed issue is low-severity handling of REPLICATE_API_TOKEN through process.env for Replicate authentication. No evidence found of prompt injection, data exfiltration, or unauthorized command execution.

remediation.suggestion: Document that REPLICATE_API_TOKEN must stay server-side, avoid committed .env files, and rotate tokens after accidental exposure.

content.user_title: Run Replicate Models from AI Workflows
content.value_statement: Developers need reliable patterns for using Replicate models without request timeouts. This skill provides setup, SDK usage, polling, and type guidance.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to install the Replicate npm package.
Shows how to configure REPLICATE_API_TOKEN for SDK authentication.
Provides a short-task pattern for direct model runs.
Provides an Inngest polling pattern for long-running predictions.
Includes TypeScript SDK type references for predictions, models, webhooks, and training.
limitations: Does not include executable helper scripts or automated setup.
Requires a valid Replicate account and API token.
Relies on the Replicate npm package and its network API.
Does not validate model inputs or webhook security by itself.

use_cases.title: Add Image Generation
use_cases.description: Use Replicate models in a TypeScript app with token setup and a direct model call.

use_cases.title: Run Long AI Jobs
use_cases.description: Design background workflows that poll Replicate until a prediction succeeds, fails, or is canceled.

use_cases.title: Type SDK Integrations
use_cases.description: Reference SDK types while planning predictions, webhooks, training jobs, and model responses.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Replicate
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add the Replicate npm package and configure REPLICATE_API_TOKEN for a TypeScript project.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Quick Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the shortest Replicate SDK pattern for running a model with a prompt input.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a Long Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Inngest polling workflow for a Replicate video generation job that may exceed a request timeout.

prompt_templates.title: Type a Production Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the reference types to design a typed Replicate prediction flow with error handling and webhook validation notes.

output_examples.input: Build a quick image generation call.
output_examples.output: A concise implementation plan that installs the SDK, reads the token, calls the model, and returns generated output.

output_examples.input: Support video generation without request timeouts.
output: A background job design using Inngest steps.
A polling loop that waits for success, failure, or cancellation.
Result handling guidance for errors and generated output.

output_examples.input: Check SDK types before integrating webhooks.
output_examples.output: A typed integration outline covering predictions, webhook events, validation, and expected response shapes.

best_practices: Keep REPLICATE_API_TOKEN server-side and out of committed files.
Use polling or background jobs for models that may exceed request timeouts.
Validate webhook signatures before trusting Replicate callback payloads.
anti_patterns: Do not expose the Replicate token in browser code.
Do not block web requests while waiting for long video generations.
Do not skip error handling for failed or canceled predictions.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps you integrate Replicate model calls, long-running predictions, and SDK types into TypeScript projects.

faq.question: Does it install the Replicate package automatically?
faq.answer: No. It explains the install command, but the user or project tooling must run it.

faq.question: Does it need a Replicate API token?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples expect REPLICATE_API_TOKEN to be available as a server-side environment variable.

faq.question: Can it handle long-running video models?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows an Inngest polling pattern for jobs that may exceed normal request timeouts.

faq.question: Does it include webhook validation guidance?
faq.answer: The reference includes webhook validation types. You still need to implement validation in your application.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
